summary: Explain dual-stack readiness during host preparation and setup
details: Add a read-only automatic P2P selection preview after CLI host prerequisite checks, including IPv4 fallback reasons and interface-specific RA recovery guidance.

Add an address-family choice to setup and show resolved families, advertised endpoints and incompatible IPv6 seeds before write confirmation. Reject a changed selection before configuration is written.
Document first-time and existing-node configuration, persistent RA settings, container inspection and actual IPv6 peer connection checks, including the limits of r28 and earlier prompts.
operator_actions: Review P2P warnings even when host software checks pass. If IPv6 is required, repair the host checks and explicitly select dual or ipv6.
For an existing node, apply repaired transport settings with peers configure; host checks do not change saved configuration or network policy.
